title: [Revelation] Somebody might posit that "words do not hurt people" or "sticks and stones may break my bones, but words can never hurt me." I detest this entirely. Not only can words hurt, but thought patterns can hurt too. Reprobation of conscience, if God reject the mind, than certainly the mind alone without any action can distance itself from God. A person could act perfectly good, but think evil thoughts. Apophatic theology, God does not punish, but he does serve penance.

title: [Revelation] Had an idea that by emulating a Paradise like the garden of Eden, it could be a symbol to God that we actually want him around us and we could get closer instead of further away.
